purpose: Replace caller evaluation_seq freshness authority with an authenticated monotonic runtime clock receipt and bind W07 telemetry to a signed secretary observation before any routing-facing shadow projection is populated.
requirements: RuntimeClockReceipt must bind mission, step, installation, runtime, monotonic clock_seq, previous_clock_hash, provider identity, key identity and nonce.
Clock receipts must be authenticated and strictly above the caller-supplied persisted minimum_clock_seq floor; exact or lower replay is rejected.
Clock predecessor hash must equal the trusted persisted prior clock receipt hash; caller cannot invent a parallel time chain.
SecretarySignalEnvelope remains source_role=W07, authority=NONE and pinned to the current WIND_SECRETARY_PROTOCOL blob.
SignedSecretaryObservation must bind the exact canonical secretary envelope fingerprint, signal_id, issued_seq, valid_through_seq and runtime scope.
A secretary signal can populate routing-facing shadow fields only when both the W07 signature and runtime clock receipt verify and clock_seq falls inside envelope/field validity.
Authority conflict always neutralizes secretary routing effect even when clock and signal signatures are valid.
Stale/future/no-fresh-field signals have zero routing effect.
Freshness is evaluated per field; stale fields are neutralized independently and cannot borrow freshness from another field.
All secretary/clock operations create zero Experience, zero operational progress and zero formal mutation authority.

trust_boundary.note: Synthetic HMAC material proves interface/authentication semantics only. Production adoption still requires independently evidenced runtime clock provider identity, protected signing keys, durable monotonic floor outside the caller rollback domain, revocation/rotation semantics and normal A->B->C verification.

forbidden_claims: Do not claim this shadow clock is a real trusted wall clock or hardware monotonic counter.
Do not claim W07 gains formal authority.
Do not claim Gearbox v2/v2.1 adoption readiness from this repair alone.
Do not treat freshness/signature maintenance as Experience or capability truth.
